resources.string: Scan the QR code shown on your PC,\nor type the code under it.
Private. Your files stay on your PC, and you approve every change.
Point the camera at the QR code on your PC
That QR code isn\'t from your PC
The camera is needed to scan the code
Go back to the previous PC
Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data. This goes away by itself as soon as there is a connection.
Your PC is on your home or office Wi-Fi, and this phone isn\'t. Connect to that Wi-Fi, or set up access from anywhere on the PC.
Your PC is on, but the app isn\'t running
Open the app on your PC (Start menu or the tray icon). This goes away by itself.
It may be switched off, asleep, or have lost its Wi-Fi or internet, or this phone may be on a different Wi-Fi. This goes away by itself as soon as it answers.
It is switched off, asleep, or has no internet connection. This goes away by itself as soon as it is back.
Check this phone\'s internet connection. If that is fine, the PC may be offline. If its address changed, scan a new code to reconnect.
Your PC has a new address
It is on this Wi-Fi, but at a different address than before. Scan the code on its page to reconnect.
It answered with an error. Give it a moment. If it keeps happening, restart the app on the PC.
Its security certificate changed since you connected. If you didn\'t reinstall the app on the PC, don\'t continue. Connect again by scanning its QR code.
For example 192.168.1.20:8765, or the address the PC page shows under Anywhere.
That doesn\'t look like an address
A plan is ready to approve, a job finished, or your PC needs an answer.
This build of the app was made without push notifications (it needs the project\'s google-services.json). Everything else works.
Couldn\'t get this phone\'s notification address. Check that it is online, then try again.
Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in the phone\'s Settings, under Apps.
